evidence.summary: The US Treasury lists Temp-Avia Arzamas Research and Production Association JSC among the 28 entities that are part of the structure of the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), which it calls a large, state-owned Russian defence conglomerate making airborne and naval weapons; OFAC designated them in March 2022. OFAC lists it as linked to KTRV, in Arzamas.
It belongs to the Tactical Missiles Corporation (KTRV), a Russian state-owned defence conglomerate.
